name: Timer
description: The Timer service allows workflows to be triggered at specific times, intervals, or after countdowns.

actions.name: At Time
actions.description: Triggered at a specific time of day (HH:mm)

actions.name: Every Day
actions.description: Triggered once every day at a specific time

actions.name: Countdown
actions.description: Triggered after a countdown in seconds

reactions.name: Wait
reactions.description: Pause workflow execution for N seconds
